eez-studio.moreDescription:
The Keysight 34465A is a 6.5-digit Truevolt DMM with 0.003% DCV accuracy and 5000 readings/second. Measures DCV, ACV, DCI, ACI, 2W/4W resistance, frequency, period, capacitance, temperature (thermocouple, RTD, thermistor), continuity, and diode.

Family covers: 34461A (6.5-digit base), 34465A (6.5-digit), 34470A (7.5-digit).

Connects via LAN port 5025 (raw SCPI) or HiSLIP. Also USB-TMC and optional GPIB.

Note: Older firmware may return 'Agilent Technologies' in IDN — update the IDN field in connection settings if auto-detection fails.

Connection: Enter the instrument IP address manually when adding to EEZ Studio (Ethernet, port 5025). Default lab address: 192.168.1.51
